role: Characterization tests for VoiceConversationController's observable surface: singleton identity, idle initial state, State equatable cases, and that the controller's textChunker splits streamed deltas like a standalone SpokenTextChunker.
types: VoiceConversationControllerTests: class (@MainActor XCTestCase) — observable-contract tests on the shared controller

units.does: Asserts VoiceConversationController.shared returns the same object twice.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass
XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Asserts each State case equals itself (idle, listening, thinking, speaking, triggerSpeaking, starting).
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

flags.text: Asserts compiler-synthesized Equatable reflexivity; it cannot fail for a payload-free enum and checks no app behaviour.

units.does: Asserts four pairs of distinct State cases are not equal.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

flags.text: Tautological check of synthesized Equatable on enum cases; cannot fail.

units.does: Resets the shared controller's textChunker, feeds three deltas, and asserts its outputs equal a fresh SpokenTextChunker's and the literal ['Run hard now.','Then rest.',nil], then finalize yields 'Next up: walk home' and a second finalize nil; resets the chunker on exit.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

flags.text: Doc comment says this pins the chunker 'the controller feeds every streamed delta through (ingestInterjectionDelta, finishInterjection)', but the test calls textChunker.append/finalize directly and never goes through those controller methods (VoiceConversationController+Audio.swift:676, :681); a regression in how the controller feeds or speaks chunks is not covered, and comparing against another SpokenTextChunker instance of the same type adds nothing beyond the literal expectations.
